mentions.name: Stripe Atlas for EU Inc.
mentions.description: This service simplifies incorporation of an EU Inc, which requires a mandatory shareholder register, and builds that register at incorporateineurope.com. It also aims to fully outsource national EU Member State taxes for a fixed monthly price so users no longer need an expensive tax consultant.
mentions.problem: Incorporating an EU Inc requires a mandatory shareholder register, and national EU Member States impose national taxes that otherwise require an expensive tax consultant.
mentions.source_excerpt: Building Stripe Atlas for EU Inc. Once approved later this year, it will be in effect as of 2027. It will simplify incorporation of an EU Inc, but requires a mandatory shareholder register, so I built that at https://incorporateineurope.com. Also, national EU Member States will impose national taxes. The goal is to be able to outsource this fully for a fixed price per month, so you don't need to worry about getting an expensive tax consultant anymore.
